Jwt._comment: AccessTokenMinutes is one token's life, not the user's: a signed-in GUI rolls its token before it lapses (POST /auth/renew), so this bounds how long a leaked token keeps working. SessionMaxDays is the absolute ceiling on that rolling, measured from the actual sign-in.

AzureAd._comment: Entra single sign-on turns on automatically once TenantId and ClientId are set (in this file, an appsettings.Development/Production overlay, or ControlPlane__AzureAd__* environment variables). Local username/password sign-in is always available alongside it. Set Enabled to true to require SSO, or false to force it off even when credentials are present.

Dispatch._comment: The in-memory run dispatcher: a node's hand-out is a lease renewed by every poll (LeaseSeconds, at least twice LongPollSeconds); a poll with free slots is held open for up to LongPollSeconds; memory is diffed against the catalog journal every ReconcileSeconds; exactly one replica dispatches, arbitrated by an ownership lease of OwnershipTtlSeconds renewed every OwnershipRenewSeconds.

DataOps._comment: The data-operations surface: an engineer's checks over live rows (the duplicate-key check, read-only measurements that emit review-ready SQL, never executing a mutating statement) and the old-versus-new baseline comparison used to prove the V3 migration. Answering a question from the data is AiContext, not this. OFF by default; with Enabled false the operations are refused at the trust boundary and /dataops/capabilities reports the switch so the GUI explains instead of erroring. Turn on with ControlPlane__DataOps__Enabled=true. LinkedServers is the allowlist a comparison may name: a linked-server name becomes an identifier in generated SQL and a route into another estate, so it is configuration, never something a request chooses. Leave Databases empty to allow any database the linked server's own login can reach.

Assistant._comment: The GUI chat assistant: the same assistant core as the Slack bot, streamed to the GUI, with every agent run forwarding the calling user's own bearer to the MCP server. Off by default; the chat endpoints then report 'not configured' and the GUI explains instead of erroring. AzureFoundry mode needs Foundry ProjectEndpoint + ModelDeploymentName and runs keyless on the app identity; OpenAI/Anthropic modes take an ApiKey (a ${env:...}/${keyvault:...} reference or a literal). Foundry TranscriptionDeploymentName (e.g. gpt-4o-mini-transcribe) additionally enables server-side voice input.

AiContext._comment: AI context: answering a question from the data the approved AI contexts open, the feature the GUI's AI context page governs. Turn it on with ControlPlane__AiContext__Enabled=true; that one switch covers a question's query (prepare and run, and the chat's Run button), saved answers (matching a question against them, and saving one), and running a trusted saved answer straight away (AutoRun, on by default; AutoRun:Enabled false makes every query wait for a click). ExpandSynonyms is left unset: it expands a question into related business words exactly when Assistant:Anthropic:ApiKey is set, so it never stops startup. SavedAnswers:RankThreshold is how many terms a saved answer must match to be trusted rather than a lead. ReportExtraction turns on uploading a Power BI report to the isolated extractor. The AI context page itself needs no switch.
